title: Acme scholarship programme update
body:
Acme and Community Foundation celebrated the graduation of 12 students in the programme’s third graduating class.
Volunteers have contributed over 800 hours to the scholarship programme.
The programme has awarded over $90,000 in scholarships to qualifying graduates.
Through its Scholarship Programme, the company has provided comprehensive bursaries totaling $4.2 million to more than 120 beneficiaries pursuing Bachelor's degrees in Science and Arts since 2022 to date. These bursaries cover tuition, accommodation and monthly stipends.
Acme aims to support local engineering education and career readiness.
